review:
A tiny 3x3, five-line game with a Chinese myth theme and a crash-style bonus. Three scatters on the first three reels send you to the launch pad.

Rockets go up carrying multipliers that grow as they climb, then explode at random – whatever your rocket shows is applied to your bet. It's light, quick and casual: medium-low volatility, a 559x cap and 96.07% RTP. If you like the idea but want real upside, Always Up! x10000 is the big-volatility version of the same game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
